All samples use exact isolated Edg/151.0.4129.86, revision @083e754915c9ab93da1d8f7b9c860e4520273900, JavaScript 15.1.23.7, protocol 1.3, and measurement authority f9710bdfaac255d7df7e8c29f251c8387041abe99a0178667b7b3430110a0409.
